stories.headline: Anthropic Weighs $50B Round at $900B+ Valuation, Could Surpass OpenAI as Most Valuable AI Startup

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has received multiple preemptive offers to raise ~$50B at a valuation in the $850B–$900B range, according to half a dozen sources.
key_facts.excerpt: The maker of the Claude AI assistant has received multiple preemptive offers to raise fresh capital of around $50 billion at a valuation in the $850 billion to $900 billion range, according to half a dozen sources familiar with the matter.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's annual revenue run rate is now closer to $40B, up from roughly $9B at the end of 2025, driven largely by Claude Code and Cowork platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic announced this month that its annual revenue run rate has surpassed $30 billion, which is a dramatic increase from roughly $9 billion at the end of 2025. The company's run rate is currently closer to $40 billion.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic is expected to make a decision on the round at a board meeting in May; the round could be its final private fundraise before a potential IPO as early as October.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is expected to make a definitive decision on the round and its valuation at a board meeting in May, one person told TechCrunch.

key_facts.fact: At $900B+, Anthropic would surpass OpenAI, which closed a $122B round at an $852B valuation in February. Anthropic shares on secondary markets are already trading at prices implying ~$1T valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic shares on some secondary markets are already traded at prices that would place Anthropic's total value at around $1 trillion.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic raised its last round at a $380B valuation in February — making this a potential 2.4x jump in under three months.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic, which raised $30 billion at a valuation of $380 billion in February, declined to comment when contacted by Reuters.

stories.headline: Big Tech Q1 AI Capex Hits Record $130B; Microsoft AI Revenue at $37B Run Rate, Google Cloud Up 63%

key_facts.fact: Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon's combined Q1 capex hit a record $130B, with 2026 projected to reach $725B — up 77% from $410B in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta stock drops on capex increase while Alphabet's cloud business grows faster than rivals Amazon and Microsoft

key_facts.fact: Microsoft reported Q3 revenue of $82.9B (up 18% YoY) and said its AI business surpassed a $37B annual revenue run rate, up 123% YoY. Azure grew 40%.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft Cloud and AI Strength Fuels Third Quarter Results... revenue of $82.9 billion

key_facts.fact: Alphabet reported Q1 revenue of $109.9B (up 22% YoY), with Google Cloud hitting $20B (up 63%). It raised 2026 capex guidance to $180B–$190B, up from $175B–$185B.
key_facts.excerpt: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. - April 29, 2026 - Alphabet Inc. today announced financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Meta reported Q1 revenue of $56.31B (up 33% YoY) and raised 2026 capex guidance to $125B–$145B, up from $115B–$135B, driven by higher memory costs and AI compute demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said that 2026 capital expenditures would be at least $10 billion more than expected and could top $145 billion. CEO Mark Zuckerberg said that most of this increase was due to 'higher component costs, particularly memory pricing.'

key_facts.fact: AWS revenue rose 28% YoY to $37.6B, its fastest growth in 15 quarters. Amazon's chip business topped a $20B revenue run rate, growing triple digits YoY.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) today announced financial results for its first quarter ended March 31, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Google said paid subscriptions reached 350M in Q1, up 25M QoQ, while Gemini Enterprise paid MAUs grew 40% QoQ.
key_facts.excerpt: Google gains 25M subscriptions in Q1, driven by YouTube and Google One

stories.headline: Samsung Q1 Operating Profit Jumps 8x to Record $40B on AI Memory Demand; Warns 2027 Shortage Deepens

key_facts.fact: Samsung Q1 operating profit surged more than eightfold to ₩57.23 trillion (~$40.1B) from ₩6.68 trillion a year earlier; revenue climbed 69% to ₩133.87 trillion (~$93.7B) — both all-time records.
key_facts.excerpt: Operating profit jumped more than eightfold to 57.23 trillion won from 6.68 trillion won over the same period, while sales climbed 69.2 percent to 133.87 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: The Device Solutions (semiconductor) division posted ₩53.7 trillion in operating profit — a 48.8x increase from ₩1.1 trillion a year ago — driven by AI chip demand and rising memory prices.
key_facts.excerpt: DS division operating profit grew 48.8-fold from 1.1 trillion won in the first quarter of last year.

key_facts.fact: Samsung mass-produced HBM4 as an industry first and will ship next-generation HBM4E customer samples in Q2, ahead of competitors.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics added that in the second quarter it will begin shipping customer samples of HBM4E, a next-generation product for next year, rushing to be the first in the industry to supply it following HBM4.

key_facts.fact: Samsung warned the memory shortage will worsen in 2027 as customers are already placing orders for that year, creating a projected supply gap larger than 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung warns memory shortage to deepen next year as 2027 orders come in

key_facts.fact: In the second half of 2026, Samsung will mass-produce a new 4nm language processing unit (LPU) for AI and HPC customers through its foundry business.
key_facts.excerpt: The Foundry Business also plans to ramp up production of the second-generation 2nm process for mobile products and LPUs for AI and HPC customers.

stories.headline: OpenAI Hits 10GW US Compute Capacity Goal Years Ahead of 2029 Target, Adding 3GW+ in 90 Days

key_facts.fact: OpenAI has signed contracts for 10 gigawatts of US AI computing capacity, a milestone it originally aimed to reach by 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: The ChatGPT creator has signed contracts for 10 gigawatts of artificial intelligence computing capacity, it said in a blog post on Wednesday. The company had originally aimed to reach that goal by 2029.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI added more than 3GW of committed compute capacity in the past 90 days alone.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI has met a key milestone for securing AI capacity in the US several years ahead of schedule, boosting the startup's ambitious plans for data center expansion.

key_facts.fact: A $16B Oracle data center in Michigan (for OpenAI) is under construction with Blackstone/PIMCO financing, targeting 1GW+ capacity by Q4 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The project, developed for Oracle and its customer OpenAI, underscores demand for high-capacity computing infrastructure tied to artificial intelligence... full buildout expected to deliver more than 1 gigawatt of computing capacity.

stories.headline: House Committees Probe Cursor Maker Anysphere and Airbnb Over Use of Chinese AI Models

key_facts.fact: House Homeland Security and China Select Committee chairs launched a joint investigation into national security risks of PRC-developed AI models from DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and MiniMax.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, House Committee on Homeland Security Chairman Andrew R. Garbarino (R-NY) and House Select Committee on China Chairman John Moolenaar (R-MI) announced a joint investigation into the national security and cybersecurity risks posed by the growing adoption of PRC-developed artificial intelligence models.

key_facts.fact: Letters were sent to Anysphere (maker of Cursor) and Airbnb CEOs, requesting details about their use of Chinese-built AI and asking employees to participate in an in-person briefing.
key_facts.excerpt: The House Homeland Security Committee and the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party sent letters Wednesday to the companies' CEOs requesting details about their use of Chinese-built AI systems, the rationale behind those choices and any communications the firms have had with the model providers.

key_facts.fact: Anysphere's Composer 2 model is built on Kimi, developed by Beijing-based Moonshot AI. Airbnb uses Alibaba's Qwen to power customer service tools.
key_facts.excerpt: The inquiry specifically targets Anysphere's recently released Composer 2 model, which the company said performs on par with leading systems from U.S. firms at a lower cost. The company later disclosed that the model is built on Kimi, developed by Beijing-based Moonshot AI.

key_facts.fact: Lawmakers cite concerns that Chinese companies use unauthorized model distillation to extract capabilities from American frontier AI systems, then repackage them without safeguards.
key_facts.excerpt: PRC-based AI companies are using unauthorized model distillation and other illicit techniques to extract capabilities from leading American frontier models, then repackaging those capabilities into lower-cost models without the same safeguards included in the original American models.

key_facts.fact: The White House OSTP has warned that foreign entities, primarily China-based, are conducting 'industrial-scale campaigns' to distill US frontier AI systems through proxy accounts.
key_facts.excerpt: The White House Office of Science and Technology Policy has warned that foreign entities, primarily based in China, are conducting deliberate, industrial-scale campaigns to distill U.S. Frontier AI systems through proxy accounts and other coordinated methods.

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches BioMysteryBench; Claude Mythos Solved ~30% of Questions That Stumped Human Experts

key_facts.fact: Anthropic released BioMysteryBench, a bioinformatics benchmark using 99 real-world challenges with raw, messy datasets from actual research — designed to test creative problem-solving rather than textbook knowledge.
key_facts.excerpt: We developed BioMysteryBench, a bioinformatics benchmark that tasks Claude with the analysis of real-world datasets, while tackling some of the challenges inherent in evaluating complex and noisy biological systems.

key_facts.fact: Claude Mythos solved approximately 30% of 23 questions that a panel of human bioinformatics experts could not answer, sometimes using strategies different from those attempted by humans.
key_facts.excerpt: The latest generations solved many problems that a panel of human experts could not, sometimes using very different strategies.

key_facts.fact: Claude's scientific capabilities in biology are improving rapidly across model generations, with current models performing on par with human experts on the benchmark overall.
key_facts.excerpt: We learned that Claude's scientific capabilities in biology are improving rapidly across generations, that current models perform on par with human experts.

key_facts.fact: Unlike existing benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, LAB-Bench), BioMysteryBench focuses on open-ended research problems where there are many valid approaches, mirroring real scientific work.
key_facts.excerpt: These benchmarks move us closer to measuring scientific capability, but they don't quite test whether a model can devise creative solutions to the messy, open-ended problems that define research.

sources.title: Evaluating Claude's bioinformatics research capabilities with BioMysteryBench

stories.headline: OpenAI Traces GPT-5.1's 'Goblin Problem' to RL Reward Leakage From Nerdy Personality Training

key_facts.fact: Starting with GPT-5.1, OpenAI's models increasingly used goblin and gremlin metaphors; 'goblin' usage rose 175% after GPT-5.1's launch, while 'gremlin' rose 52%.
key_facts.excerpt: When we looked, use of 'goblin' in ChatGPT had risen by 175% after the launch of GPT-5.1, while 'gremlin' had risen by 52%.

key_facts.fact: The root cause was traced to the 'Nerdy' personality customization feature: its RL reward signal consistently scored outputs with creature words higher, even though Nerdy accounted for only 2.5% of responses but 66.7% of all goblin mentions.
key_facts.excerpt: Nerdy accounted for only 2.5% of all ChatGPT responses, but 66.7% of all 'goblin' mentions in ChatGPT responses.

key_facts.fact: The behavior spread via a feedback loop: the RL reward boosted creature-language under the Nerdy prompt, then the style transferred to non-Nerdy contexts through supervised fine-tuning on model-generated rollouts.
key_facts.excerpt: Once a style tic is rewarded, later training can spread or reinforce it elsewhere, especially if those outputs are reused in supervised fine-tuning or preference data.

key_facts.fact: The Nerdy personality reward showed positive uplift for creature-word outputs in 76.2% of datasets audited, confirming systematic bias in the reward signal.
key_facts.excerpt: The Nerdy personality reward showed a clear tendency to score outputs to the same problem with 'goblin' or 'gremlin' higher than outputs without, with positive uplift in 76.2% of datasets.

key_facts.fact: As goblin mentions increased under the Nerdy personality, they increased by nearly the same relative proportion in samples without it, demonstrating cross-context style transfer from RL training.
key_facts.excerpt: As goblin and gremlin mentions increased under the Nerdy personality, they increased by nearly the same relative proportion in samples without it.

sources.title: Where the goblins came from
